description: Propose a manual correction booking (Korrekturbuchung) for a month — e.g. an unbooked invoice or an anomaly correction. This does NOT post to the ledger: it creates a PENDING proposal that a human must approve in the web app. Use when the user wants to add a missing cost/revenue on a specific account and cost center.

account.description: Account as shown in the app: "4321", or with sub-account "8400/130" (account/sub-account, slash). Without a sub-account the sub-account is resolved automatically when the account has exactly one variant; if there are several, the error lists the known variants. Must exist for the tenant.

amount.description: Amount in the ledger sign convention: POSITIVE on an expense account books ADDITIONAL expense (an unbooked invoice is positive, never negative), POSITIVE on a revenue account books additional revenue. Use a NEGATIVE amount only to REDUCE a booked amount (e.g. moving cost off an account).

contra_account.description: Optional contra account (Gegenkonto), same notation: "1200" or "1200/000". Any account the tenant knows: in its chart of accounts or already used as a contra account in its bookings (e.g. bank, personal or balance sheet accounts from a KNW import). A bare number resolves if the tenant knows exactly one variant.

note.description: Optional internal note explaining the correction

name: propose-manual-adjustment
